purpose: Close ASVS V14.2.3: confine analytics to a fail-closed public boundary, remove session replay, resolve the two contradictory CSPs, and correct a merged decision note that overstated the exposure.
requiredInvariants: The boundary is deny-by-default: an unrecognised path gets no analytics markup, script or pixel.
No security control is widened; in particular no CSP gains a third-party host.
Session replay is removed rather than reconfigured, because no safe public-only boundary can be demonstrated.
Field-level masking is never offered as the primary protection.
The noscript pixel is treated as a separate exposure from the script, because CSP does not stop an image.
A merged decision note found to be overstated is corrected in place, not quietly restated.
No product business logic beyond the analytics boundary, and no production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: Every private and credential-bearing path family is denied, enumerated explicitly in the test rather than inferred.
An unknown path, an empty path and a relative path all fail closed.
A private path cannot masquerade as an allowlisted prefix (/legal-internal, /trustee).
The root layout contains no analytics markup at all.
next.config.js no longer names the analytics host.
Measured against a running server: the cabinet page carried the snippet and the pixel before and carries neither after.
V14.2.3 moves FAIL to PASS, and its note records the correction to the earlier overstatement.
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions at the head.
